title: Recursive integral root sections locally span positive powers
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l and a scheme T. For a family G_d(V,a,x) satisfying the degree-zero, degree-one and successor root recursion equations of lem-weil-integral-root-power-generators, every section of the d-th coefficient tensor power becomes, on a covering sieve, a finite linear combination of sections G_d(V,a,x).

source.place: section-tensor-product, Tags 03EK and 03EL; local generation by sheafification and tensor induction

proof.text: At degree zero the tensor power is the coefficient sheaf, so the given degree-zero formula supplies the spanning family.

At degree one, use the sheafification unit for scalar extension. Tensor-product induction expresses every presheaf section as a finite sum of scalar/root tensors, and the degree-one equation identifies each with a displayed G section.

For degree d+2, the tensor power is the sheafification of the presheaf tensor product of degree d+1 and degree one; the sheafification unit is locally surjective, so it suffices to treat pure tensors of sections that locally lie in the respective spans. Refine the two local spans to a common covering sieve, expand bilinearly (moving scalars of either factor out by balancing), and use the successor equation for G. The resulting finite sums lie in the displayed submodule span on the common refinement; the local span is stable under restriction because restriction maps generators to generators.

theorem integralRootPower_local_spanning
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (T : Scheme.{u})
    (G : ∀ (d : ℕ) (V : T.ProEtᵒᵖ)
      (_a : (completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted l E T).obj.obj V),
      (Fin d → (purTwistZlOne T l).obj.obj V) →
        (coefficientTwistPower T (R := (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E T))
          (purTwistIntegralModule T l E) d).val.obj V)
    (hzero : ∀ V a x, G 0 V a x = a)
    (hone : ∀ V a x, G 1 V a (fun _ ↦ x) =
      @SMul.smul _ _ (purTwistIntegralAction T l E V).toSMul a
          (purTwistIntegralTensor T l E V 1 x))
    (hsucc : ∀ d V a x, G (d + 2) V a x =
      SheafOfModules.siteSheafTensorTmul.{u + 1, u, u + 1, u + 1}
        (coefficientTwistPower T (R := (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E T))
          (purTwistIntegralModule T l E) (d + 1))
        (purTwistIntegralModule T l E) V (G (d + 1) V a (fun i ↦ x i.castSucc))
        (purTwistIntegralTensor T l E V 1 (x (Fin.last (d + 1))))) :
    IntegralRootPowerLocallySpans l E T G
